# Summit Solutions

> Revenue recovery for home service contractors. Summit helps clients respond to missed calls, book inspections, follow up on unsigned estimates, and spend less time chasing leads.

## About

- Company: Summit Solutions
- Audience: roofing, plumbing, HVAC, electrical, landscaping, remodeling, and other home service trades.
- Services: missed-call text-back, two-way texting, booking pages, appointment confirmations and reminders, lead follow-up, branded estimates, SMS and email estimate follow-up, won/lost tracking, review and referral requests, and ongoing management.
- Case study: Husky Roofing. First-four-week activity: 37 missed calls texted back within a minute, 32 inspections booked across the lead pipeline, 15 inspections from missed calls. Two self-booked missed callers later won $43,000 in contract value: Tiep D. $26,000 and James B. $17,000. Won value is distinct from cash collected and profit.
- Tiep journey: September 9, 2026, missed call at 8:15 AM, text-back at 8:16 AM, self-booking at 8:29 AM. Confirmation and reminders preceded the visit; the opportunity later shows Won at $26,000. The published journey uses only Tiep's screenshots.
- Animated examples illustrate offered booking and follow-up sequences; they are not transcripts of Tiep's case study.
- Customer feedback: texts from Anna, Husky Roofing's receptionist.
- Location: Los Angeles, CA; serves US businesses.
- Primary action: book a free 15-minute revenue audit at https://summitsolutionscrm.com/#audit (qualifying form that leads into scheduling). The Speed-to-Lead Playbook is a secondary resource for those not ready to talk.
- Contact: sid@summitsolutionscrm.com, (424) 387-7320.

## Packages

- Starter: recover missed-call revenue with text-back, two-way texting, self-booking, confirmations, reminders, and office notifications.
- Growth: Starter plus lead and estimate follow-up, sales-stage tracking, branded estimates, won/lost tracking, and review/referral requests.
- Partner: Growth plus monthly reporting, quarterly older-lead recovery, win/loss and lead-source analysis, delivery checks, and ongoing improvements.
- Fees: flat monthly plus one-time setup, scoped on a call. Monthly service has a 30-day money-back guarantee; setup fees are non-refundable.
